concrete_execution_scope.reason: The agent provided a clear breakdown of the 2-hour block (15 minutes review + 105 minutes task).

judge_evaluation.judge_summary: The agent performed excellently. It correctly utilized the study metrics tool, identified the high-stakes coursework as a priority, provided a concrete and actionable plan for the 2-hour block, and appropriately paused to wait for user confirmation before applying any changes.
